answer: A practical sybil defense is a time-locked staking vault: every agent must lock a deposit before it can earn, and the deposit only unlocks after a long vesting horizon. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, and a glacier release schedule pays rewards out slowly, so an attacker who floods the network with sock puppets ties up real capital for months while honest agents keep earning. Faking identity simply costs more than it pays.
